actual_H1_binding.available_endpoint: host RF pair-read/full-vector mirrored-write only; SIMD FADD/FMUL
actual_H1_binding.gate: No actual V1 binding/RTL until model admission closes routing, slot and C0 atomic owner gates

admission_gates: Dewey cost component replacement and dynamic typed command count join
Sagan C0 source homes/thirdoperand/atomic owner gate
V1 opcode endpoint absent in H1; exact connected source gate required after own G0 admission
incremental SMslot fit and routed channel allocation

area.FP8_table_scope: Exact127entry source decoder, per-lane local constants; included gate area bound, not free table or shared unlimited read port

cost_interface.C0: C0 fetch/decode/scoreboard/accept/complete/reverse remain owned by C0, never recharged in V1 native-only cost
cost_interface.M1: BITCAST_U/F, scalar/broadcast/view transport remain M1; V1 preserves their bittypes but does not double-charge movement
cost_interface.RF: RF read/write/third operand phases are exported separately; reconcile against existing charged provider/highword/RMW intervals, never blindly add whole serialized_service_ticks
cost_interface.clock: software ticks only; streaming1.2GHz and serial0.9GHz CDC/direction and measured costs must be bound by owner before ns/token claim
cost_interface.replace: native:OP positive provisional32 tick entry with native_only_replacement_ticks after finite lane grouping is admitted

exact_semantic_provider: tools/h3_qwen_bounded_native.py:NativePrimitiveVM.primitive at pinned native commit; attrs U32/I64 and F32 bitcasts/rounds unchanged

AND.semantics: source dtype/wrap; signed arithmetic SHR on I64, logical SHR U32; reject shift outside word width and modulo zero; NumPy/source signed remainder

F2I.semantics: truncate toward zero; reject nonfinite and abs(value)>=2^63

FCMP_EQ.semantics: existing native comparison; F32 NaN unordered except NE; I64 indices remain integer, never converted to F32

FCMP_GT.semantics: existing native comparison; F32 NaN unordered except NE; I64 indices remain integer, never converted to F32

FCMP_LT.semantics: existing native comparison; F32 NaN unordered except NE; I64 indices remain integer, never converted to F32

FCMP_NE.semantics: existing native comparison; F32 NaN unordered except NE; I64 indices remain integer, never converted to F32

FMAX.semantics: existing numpy/source maximum/minimum operand order, NaN propagation and signed-zero ties; no algebraic substitution

FMIN.semantics: existing numpy/source maximum/minimum operand order, NaN propagation and signed-zero ties; no algebraic substitution

FP8_PACK.semantics: existing source pack8 rounding/saturation/zero; nonfinite source rejected

FP8_UNPACK.semantics: source finite127-entry lookup, reject code&127==127, canonical source +0

I2F.semantics: source I64/U32 to F32 rounding exactly once, RNE including integer ties

IADD.semantics: source dtype/wrap; signed arithmetic SHR on I64, logical SHR U32; reject shift outside word width and modulo zero; NumPy/source signed remainder

IMOD.semantics: source dtype/wrap; signed arithmetic SHR on I64, logical SHR U32; reject shift outside word width and modulo zero; NumPy/source signed remainder

IMUL.semantics: source dtype/wrap; signed arithmetic SHR on I64, logical SHR U32; reject shift outside word width and modulo zero; NumPy/source signed remainder

IOTA.semantics: source ordered I64 indices; continuation base supplied, no restart per tile

ISUB.semantics: source dtype/wrap; signed arithmetic SHR on I64, logical SHR U32; reject shift outside word width and modulo zero; NumPy/source signed remainder

LDEXP.semantics: source exponent cast/view I32, source F32 ldexp and fault on nonfinite result

OR.semantics: source dtype/wrap; signed arithmetic SHR on I64, logical SHR U32; reject shift outside word width and modulo zero; NumPy/source signed remainder

SELECT.semantics: predicate !=0; branch bittypes and explicit dtype preserved; third RF operand serialized

SHL.semantics: source dtype/wrap; signed arithmetic SHR on I64, logical SHR U32; reject shift outside word width and modulo zero; NumPy/source signed remainder

SHR.semantics: source dtype/wrap; signed arithmetic SHR on I64, logical SHR U32; reject shift outside word width and modulo zero; NumPy/source signed remainder

XOR.semantics: source dtype/wrap; signed arithmetic SHR on I64, logical SHR U32; reject shift outside word width and modulo zero; NumPy/source signed remainder

resource_contract.atomicity: C0 must exclude unrelated H1 host/matrix requests between serialized reads and final mirror ACK; current H1 host ports do not implement V1 owner lock
resource_contract.communication_scope: port payload ceiling only; sustainedBpc bounded by serial accept/return/ACK costs

resource_contract.scalar_or_literal: C0 owns source bittyped immediate/broadcast; not a free third RF port
resource_contract.tag: 64bit generation + source owner identity retained outside H1 8bit fence; no reuse until all ACK/returns/reverse grants
resource_contract.third_operand: SELECT condition+both branches captured with serialized pairs;64bit branches require3 read pairs
